errors.evidence: The chart displays a blue area chart representing total revenue, not a blue line chart.
The description omits the percentage growth value for 2022, which is 19% and also represents the peak growth rate in the depicted period.

The description only mentions the start and end values for the total revenue, omitting the explicitly labeled intermediate values for the years 2018 (10.80), 2019 (12.20), 2020 (14.00), 2021 (16.20), and 2022 (19.30).

The description incorrectly states there is an upward trend for the growth rate ('ръста'). The chart shows the growth rate fluctuates, decreasing from 14% to 13%, then rising to a peak of 19% before dropping sharply to 7%. This is not a consistent upward trend.
